name: Christmas
author: NaderLabs
description: A Cold-War ops room running Christmas Eve: the situation display (Santa tracker), production (an isometric toy line), the morale feed (Santa's band), the SAT feed (snow over a village, reindeer and Santa) and the rec room (a rave in a snowglobe), all under one console with a SLEIGHCON alert level, plus two cutaways: the sleigh road (Santa's sleigh run on a Christmas star road) and the Christmas house (a pixel house whose windows light per note, after the Halloween haunted house); the evergreen and norad palettes.
